sequence.subject: Should I close the loop on this?
sequence.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I reached out a couple times about helping {{company_name}} handle overflow calls during peak season.

I'm guessing one of three things:
1. You're all set (and if so, great — ignore me)
2. You're interested but swamped (totally get it)
3. This isn't a priority right now

If it's #2, I can make this ridiculously easy. One 10-minute call, I'll show you exactly how we help HVAC firms capture more calls. Then you decide.

If it's #1 or #3, just reply "not now" and I'll close the loop.

Either way, hope {{company_name}} has a great summer.

{{sender_name}}
The One Group

sequence.subject: One last thing about {{company_name}}'s intake
sequence.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I've reached out a couple times about improving intake at {{company_name}}.

Here's my honest take: if you're already capturing 100% of calls and converting them efficiently, then we're not a fit. And that's fine — plenty of firms have this dialed in.

But if there's even a 10% gap between calls received and consultations booked, that's real money walking out the door.

I'm not asking for a commitment. Just 15 minutes to see if there's an opportunity you're missing.

If not, no hard feelings. I'll close your file and won't follow up further.

{{sender_name}}

sequence.subject: Re: What {{similar_firm}} did differently this tax season

sequence.subject: Quick question about {{company_name}}'s client experience
sequence.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I've reached out a couple times about call handling for {{company_name}}. No pressure — just wanted to ask one thing:

When your clients call during tax season and get voicemail, what happens?

Do they:
A) Leave a detailed message and wait patiently?
B) Call the next accountant on their list?

I've seen it go both ways. But the firms that answer every call? They keep more clients.

If you're interested in making sure {{company_name}} is in category A, happy to chat. If not, I'll close the loop and stop following up.

Either way, best of luck with extension season.

{{sender_name}}
The One Group
